create_program_database: create an in-memory ProgramDatabase instance using Config with database.in_memory set to True
add_and_get_program: add a Program with id, code, language, and metrics to the database and retrieve it by id
sample_program_for_evolution: sample a parent program and inspirations from the database for evolutionary mutation
setup_multi_island_database: create a ProgramDatabase with multiple islands and add programs to specific target islands
migrate_programs_between_islands: migrate programs between islands at configured intervals and validate no program is assigned to multiple islands
